research.title: AWS Research & Architecture Design: HMRC Tax Assistant ChatBot

controlFields.Distribution: HMRC Architecture Review Board, GDS Stakeholders
HMRC AI Governance, Data Ethics Committee, GDS, GOV.UK ATRS Repository
controlFields.User Experience: Phone anxiety, long waits, business-hours only
controlFields.Age: **Older citizens** (65+) may have lower digital literacy, struggle with text-based chat
controlFields.Disability:
**Visual impairments**: Cannot use chat without screen reader
**Cognitive disabilities**: May find AI responses complex
controlFields.Race: **Ethnic minorities** may experience lower AI accuracy if training data biased toward white British demographics
controlFields.Sex: **Women** may receive different quality guidance if training data biased (e.g., historically male-dominated tax scenarios)
controlFields.Religion: **Religious minorities** may have specific tax questions (e.g., Zakat, religious donations)
controlFields.Gender Reassignment: **Transgender citizens** may face PII exposure if ChatBot requests gender unnecessarily

ARC-001-EVAL-v1.0.title: Vendor Evaluation Criteria: HMRC Tax Guidance ChatBot

controlFields.Distribution: HMRC Procurement, Architecture Team, Finance, Legal, Evaluation Committee
controlFields.MQ-1: **Experience**: Minimum 5 years delivering AI/ML systems for UK Government or equivalent public sector
controlFields.MQ-2: **Security Clearance**: Key personnel eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. Company eligible for UK Gov contracts.
controlFields.MQ-3: **Reference Projects**: Minimum 3 reference projects in past 3 years demonstrating AI/ML, cloud (AWS/Azure), UK Gov authentication integration.
controlFields.MQ-4: **Certifications - Company**: Cyber Essentials Plus (current, not expired). G-Cloud 14 listing or eligibility.
controlFields.MQ-5: **Certifications - Key Personnel**: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional (or equivalent), CISSP/CEH (Security Architect), AWS ML Specialty (AI/ML Lead), WCAG 2.2 AA certification (Accessibility Specialist).
controlFields.MQ-6: **Financial Stability**: Minimum �5M annual revenue (past 2 years). Professional liability insurance �5M, cyber liability �2M.
controlFields.MQ-7: **UK Presence**: UK office or registered UK subsidiary. Minimum 50% onshore team allocation.
controlFields.MQ-8: **Accessibility Expertise**: At least 1 dedicated accessibility specialist with WCAG 2.2 AA certification and experience delivering compliant public sector services.
controlFields.MQ-9: **Proposal Compliance - Timeliness**: Proposal submitted by 2025-12-09 at 5:00 PM GMT.
controlFields.MQ-10: **Proposal Compliance - Format**: Technical proposal and cost proposal in separate PDF files. All required sections completed (Executive Summary, Company Overview, Technical Solution, Project Approach, Team, Experience, Assumptions). Page limits adhered to.
controlFields.MQ-11: **Proposal Compliance - Key Personnel CVs**: CVs provided for Solution Architect, AI/ML Lead, Technical Lead, Security Architect.
controlFields.MQ-12: **Proposal Compliance - Evidence of Qualifications**: Cyber Essentials Plus certificate, G-Cloud 14 listing, financial statements, insurance certificates, key personnel certifications provided.

ARC-001-SOW-v1.0.title: Statement of Work (SOW): HMRC Tax Guidance ChatBot

controlFields.Document Type: Procurement - Statement of Work / Request for Proposal (RFP)
controlFields.Distribution: HMRC Procurement, Architecture Team, GDS Stakeholders, Vendor Community
controlFields.High-Level Design (HLD): Solution architecture, C4 diagrams (Context, Container, Component), technology stack, integration patterns
controlFields.Detailed Design (DLD): Component specs, API contracts (OpenAPI 3.0+), data models, security controls, RAG architecture
controlFields.Security Design: Threat model (NCSC methodology), security controls mapping (NCSC Cloud Security Principles), penetration test plan
controlFields.Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA): UK GDPR compliance assessment, data flows, risks, mitigations
controlFields.Equality Impact Assessment (EqIA): Impact on protected characteristics (Equality Act 2010), accessibility strategy
controlFields.Algorithmic Transparency Record (ATRS): Tier 1 (public summary) + Tier 2 (technical details), AI model, data sources, bias testing plan
controlFields.Test Strategy: Unit, integration, E2E, accessibility, AI accuracy, bias, performance, security testing approach
controlFields.Source Code: All application code (backend, frontend, AI pipeline)
controlFields.Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform modules for all AWS resources
controlFields.Database Schemas: DDL scripts, migration scripts (Flyway or Liquibase), seed data
controlFields.API Documentation: Full API reference with examples, authentication guide
controlFields.Unit Tests: Automated unit tests for all components
controlFields.Integration Tests: Automated integration tests for component interactions
controlFields.AI Accuracy Tests: Ground truth dataset (1000+ queries) with automated accuracy evaluation
controlFields.Performance Test Results: Load testing results (10,000 concurrent users, 500 req/s sustained)
controlFields.Security Test Results: SAST, DAST, dependency scans, penetration test report (CHECK-approved supplier)
controlFields.Accessibility Test Results: Automated (axe-core, Pa11y) + manual (assistive technologies) testing results
controlFields.Bias and Fairness Test Results: Bias testing across protected characteristics (age, gender, ethnicity, disability)
controlFields.User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Report: Private beta (100 citizens) + public beta (10,000 citizens) feedback and metrics
controlFields.Deployed Application (Private Beta): Fully functional ChatBot in private beta environment
controlFields.Deployed Application (Public Beta): Fully functional ChatBot in public beta environment
controlFields.CI/CD Pipeline: Automated build, test, security scan, deploy pipeline
controlFields.Monitoring & Alerting: Dashboards (operational + business KPIs), SLO-based alerts, runbooks
controlFields.Disaster Recovery Plan: DR procedures, backup/restore scripts, multi-AZ failover
controlFields.Technical Documentation: Architecture, design decisions, component docs, code comments
controlFields.Operations Manual: System administration, monitoring, scaling, backup/restore procedures
controlFields.Runbooks: Deployment, rollback, scaling, incident response procedures
controlFields.User Manual (Staff): Training materials for HMRC staff (content designers, support team)
controlFields.Technical Training: Architecture walkthrough, codebase tour, deployment procedures, troubleshooting
controlFields.Operations Training: Monitoring, incident response, scaling, backup/restore, disaster recovery
controlFields.Content Management Training: Knowledge base ingestion, content updates, quality assurance
controlFields.Support Team Training: ChatBot features, escalation procedures, common issues
controlFields.Solution Architect: 10+ years, AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, UK Gov experience
controlFields.Security Architect: 8+ years, CISSP or equivalent, NCSC Cloud Security Principles expertise
controlFields.AI/ML Lead: 8+ years, AWS Certified ML Specialty, RAG architecture experience
controlFields.Senior Backend Engineers (Node.js/Go): 5+ years Node.js or Go, API development
controlFields.Senior Frontend Engineer (React/TypeScri: 5+ years React, GOV.UK Design System experience
controlFields.Accessibility Specialist: WCAG 2.2 AA certified, assistive technology testing
controlFields.Content Designer: Plain English writing, GOV.UK style guide experience
controlFields.Technical Writer: API documentation, technical writing for developers
